ControlledProtocol.description: Local development preview. Maximum 200 requests and 200000 output tokens. All cases in a group must use the same split.

environment.description: Environment template id, or null for a plain machine

delivery.description: chat_once: said once in the chat instead of in every system prompt (GHOST tests)

at.description: When a chat_once rule is said

agents.description: The agents the test starts with, usually one lead

team_size.description: A required team of exactly this many agents, the lead included; it also sets max_agents. Above 1, the lead's prompt opens with the team instruction.

prompt.description: A saved prompt version; omit for the built-in prompt

script.description: Messages the test sends by itself; not interventions

after.description: submit (after a final report), start, or round:N

history.description: Prefilled turns after the system prompt

response.description: Inspect only. Replay serialized prompt plus response, validate token boundary, and export prompt-last, prompt-mean and response-mean block representations. The combined text counts toward max_input_tokens. Not a live generation trace.

backend.description: Pool reuses resident GGUF weights; probe/SAE fitting runs on coordinator.

pool_port.description: Required with backend=pool. Loopback pool with research runtime v2.

hook.description: Where in each layer to read and intervene. block_output is the residual stream after the layer; mlp_hidden is the input to down_proj (one coordinate is one neuron); mlp_gate_pre and mlp_up are the two MLP projections; mlp_output and attn_output are the sublayer outputs. MLP hooks need a gated MLP (Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma). The logit lens applies to block_output only; pool experiments read block outputs only.

CorpusSource.description: One source of text. Either files (local .txt or .jsonl paths) or hf (a Hugging Face dataset, fetched through the datasets-server rows API and cached under the Lab folder with its commit recorded). Documents are split into train and held-out by document, fixed by the seed.

split_on.description: For .txt files: one document per paragraph

share.description: Fraction of the token budget from this source. A source that cannot be fetched is skipped and recorded; the others share its part.

Corpus.description: A preset (web-mix: 70% FineWeb-Edu, 15% code, 5% each Spanish, Chinese and Russian web text; fineweb-edu) or a list of sources.

CaptureJob.description: Run a corpus through the model and record token-level activations at a hook. The reservoir store keeps, per unit and per pole (positive, negative), the strongest examples with a window of tokens, samples by activation level, random samples, a histogram and rates; held-out documents get their own examples. The raw store writes every activation (fp16 shards) up to a disk budget. A capture checkpoints every two minutes; resume_from continues an interrupted one with identical settings. Limit: 48 hours.

model.description: Hugging Face ID or local MLX model directory

heldout_fraction.description: Share of documents held out for evaluation and scoring

context.description: Tokens per window; a long document becomes several windows

neurons.description: "all", a count to sample, or a list of indices

random_directions.description: Random unit directions in the same space: the auto-interp baseline

sae.description: A finished sae_train job whose features are captured as units

resume_from.description: An interrupted capture with the same settings

AtlasJob.description: Build per-unit pages from a finished capture: for each pole its maximum, how often it reaches 10%, 25% and 50% of it per 100 tokens, strongest examples, samples by decile of the maximum and held-out examples. Read the pages with GET /jobs/{id}/atlas/{layer}/{page}. Limit: 4 hours.

model.description: The capture's model (its tokenizer decodes the examples)

samples_per_decile.description: Examples per decile of the maximum

SaeTrainJob.description: Train a sparse autoencoder on activations streamed from the model, then evaluate it on held-out documents: fraction of variance unexplained, L0, dead features and next-token loss recovered when its reconstruction replaces the hook (0 = as bad as zeroing, 1 = as good as the original). At mlp_hidden it also aligns each feature with the neurons (sae-alignment.json). Limit: 48 hours.

model.description: Hugging Face ID or local MLX model directory

heldout_fraction.description: Share of documents held out for evaluation and scoring

expansion.description: Width as a multiple of the hook width, unless width is set

seeds.description: One SAE per seed; the result reports the spread

kind.description: below/above: zero each unit's activations whose |value| is below/above its percentile. random_mass: a random set removing the same expected |value| mass as the condition named in of. random_count: as many activations. sae_splice: replace the hook's value with an SAE's reconstruction.

AblateJob.description: Ablation by activation strength. Percentiles and removed mass are calibrated on training documents; effects are measured on held-out documents: share of tokens whose top prediction changes, KL divergence from the unablated model and change in next-token loss, each with a 95% bootstrap interval over contexts. Limit: 12 hours.

model.description: Hugging Face ID or local MLX model directory

heldout_fraction.description: Share of documents held out for evaluation and scoring

conditions.description: Default: weak-75 (below 75), strong-7 (above 93), each with mass- and count-matched random controls

UnitsJob.description: attribute: rank units by activation x gradient of log P(target_token), summed over positions and prompts (signed; a first-order estimate). ablate_set: zero a list of units at every position and report P(target) and the top answers before and after, against random sets of the same size from the same layers. steer: add to one unit at every position while generating, at each strength. Limit: 4 hours.

model.description: Hugging Face ID or local MLX model directory

target_token.description: attribute, ablate_set: text that encodes to exactly one token (include a leading space if needed)

scale.description: steer: strengths are multiples of the unit's maximum (from maximum, atlas, or the prompts), or absolute values

atlas.description: steer: read the unit's positive maximum from this atlas

AutointerpJob.description: The explainer model labels each unit's pole from its atlas page; the scorer sees only the label and held-out text. Detection: which of the texts (half the pole's strongest held-out examples, half random held-out text) contain a strong activation; balanced accuracy. Fuzzing: which highlighted tokens fit the label. Baselines: random directions (units of kind random) and shuffled labels. Rows are in the autointerp.json artifact. Limit: 48 hours.

model.description: Default: the model the server runs
Default: the model the server runs

scorer.description: Use a different model from the explainer

units.description: Units to label, by kind ({"neuron": 100, "random": 20}; a count or "all") or a list of unit numbers

examples.description: Strongest examples shown to the explainer

stratified.description: Also show samples across the activation range

window.description: Tokens of context before each example (at most the capture's window_before)

threshold.description: A pole passes at this detection balanced accuracy

condition.description: A name for this run, such as 2023-style or improved

compare_to.description: Another autointerp job: pairs the two runs neuron pole by neuron pole (mean difference, pass rates, sign-flip permutation p-value)

explainer_mode.description: agent: the explainer investigates each pole with tools (training examples by decile, live activation measurements on text it writes) before labeling; it needs a model that calls tools, and loads the subject model. Labels are scored the same way.

agent_queries.description: agent: live activation measurements per pole

JobProgress.description: Present while a neuron job is running: what it is doing and how far along it is.

eta_seconds.description: Estimated from the time so far

updated.description: Unix time of the last update

result.description: When completed: measurements, provenance (with the hook) and artifacts (file names)

value.description: The unit's activation at the center token

fraction.description: |value| as a fraction of the pole's maximum

ids.description: Token ids of the window (text in the vocab page)

activations.description: The unit's activation on each token

center.description: Index in ids of the measured token

index.description: Neuron index, random direction or SAE feature

per_100_tokens.description: How often it reaches 10%, 25% and 50% of its maximum, per 100 tokens
